As I prepared the ritual site after years of work, one of the naga slew me, and my bones were taken. Reclaim my bones, from the slithering foe, and find someone who can help me. ==Rewards== * 5875 experience ==Progress== You have returned... ==Completion== The bones of one my kin you say, haunted by Kami? The thing we must do is burn the bones, and free the curse. You have helped one of my kin, redeemed her in the eyes of the kami, cast aside her dishonor, and saved her soul. Her spirit is free to be reborn once more. Take this as a symbol of my gratitude. ==Notes== ;Upon completion :'''Spirit of the Senshi says:''' I am... free. The dark Kami's vile hold over me is gone.
